svg.aria-label: Reference architecture for the Chain Risk Copilot: an Ethereum node streams through a producer into Kafka while AWS public blockchain Parquet is backfilled by Airflow; both land in a bronze layer, pass a reorg and reconciliation stage, and are modelled by dbt into silver and gold layers with SCD2 dimensions, which serve a guardrailed LangGraph risk copilot and BI dashboards, over a cross-cutting platform and governance layer.
svg.text: Project 1 · Ethereum · dual-path ingestion → medallion warehouse → governed AI copilot
